purpose: Forensic discrepancy register and remediation mapping for CI dependency blocker resolution, adversarial trust-boundary hardening, and architectural isolation review under CTO Directive 113.
governance: Master Execution Framework Amendment v1.2 / Rule IV-001 (Non-Self-Acceptance)

discrepancies.priorReportValue: In published commit 7a38b4a (and previous D110/D111 commits), remote GitHub Actions run 39270699898 failed on Step 4 ('Install dependencies') across all 4 jobs with code ERESOLVE: Could not resolve dependency @config-plugins/react-native-webrtc@12.0.0 requiring peer expo: '^53', while root project requires expo: '^54.0.0'.
discrepancies.canonicalCommittedValue: apps/mobile/package.json updated @config-plugins/react-native-webrtc from ^12.0.0 to ^13.0.0. @config-plugins/react-native-webrtc@13.0.0 specifies peerDependencies.expo: '^54', matching Expo 54. package-lock.json regenerated cleanly without --force or --legacy-peer-deps. Clean-install validated via npm ci --dry-run (exit code 0, 0 ERESOLVE errors). All WebRTC mobile functionality preserved.
discrepancies.representationOrigin: Project upgraded to Expo 54 in prior milestone, but @config-plugins/react-native-webrtc was left pinned to 12.0.0 (Expo 53 peer).
discrepancies.historicalLineage: Uncovered when CI workflow quoting fix in D111 allowed jobs to execute their step graphs on GitHub Actions runners.
discrepancies.resolutionAction: Upgraded @config-plugins/react-native-webrtc to ^13.0.0 in apps/mobile/package.json; regenerated package-lock.json; verified npm ci clean install reproducibility.

discrepancies.priorReportValue: In Directive 111 Test 2.6, bypass mode flags (e.g. testMode: true, allowOverrides: true, bypassLedgerValidation: true) were passed in combination with expectedHashOverride: 'TAMPERED'. Because expectedHashOverride was itself rejected as a forbidden key, the test passed due to the expectedHashOverride check, failing to prove that each bypass flag in isolation was ineffective.
discrepancies.canonicalCommittedValue: Disentangled all bypass flag tests. Each flag is tested strictly in isolation against all 4 public verifier entry points without expectedHashOverride. Hardened assertNoCallerTrustOverrides in scripts/internal/reconcile_engine.mjs to reject non-object inputs (null, primitives, arrays), inherited prototype properties (using key in options), unknown/unapproved options (restricting public options strictly to APPROVED_PUBLIC_OPTIONS = ['repoRoot']), and expanded caller trust material overrides. Added 24 isolated tests in Suite 33.
discrepancies.representationOrigin: D111 test authoring combined multiple attack vectors into a single test object rather than isolating each parameter under test.
discrepancies.historicalLineage: Identified in CTO Directive 113 review as an adversarial test validity gap; fully resolved in D113 Workstream B.
discrepancies.resolutionAction: Refactored D111 Test 2.6 to test flags in isolation; hardened assertNoCallerTrustOverrides with prototype scanning and unknown key rejection; created dedicated Suite 33 with comprehensive isolation tests.

discrepancies.priorReportValue: D110/D111 reports ambiguously described scripts/internal/reconcile_engine.mjs as having 'runtime isolation' or 'module privacy', which could imply an in-process VM sandbox or Node.js module encapsulation boundary preventing arbitrary imports.
discrepancies.canonicalCommittedValue: Truthfully codified that Node.js ECMAScript Modules do not enforce process-level privacy or unforgeable isolation between workspace files. The boundary is an architectural repository convention, an acyclic static DAG (Layer 0 has 0 relative repo imports), and a build/deployment boundary verified by static AST reachability audits (0 application imports across 444 files in apps/api/src, apps/mobile, and packages). Public entry points wrap internal payloads safely, preserving single-implementation verification without code duplication.
discrepancies.representationOrigin: CTO Directive 113 review requirement to establish realistic security claims.
discrepancies.historicalLineage: D108 created internal engine; D110 scoped exports; D111 audited reachability; D113 precisely articulates architectural vs VM security guarantees.
discrepancies.resolutionAction: Documented exact architectural guarantee (repository convention, acyclic static DAG, and build/deploy boundary); verified zero application reachability across 444 files; validated single-implementation integrity.
